item.title: Meeting of the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) – Rescheduled
item.description:
As announced in the Reserve Bank’s Press Release: 2026-2027/9999 dated March 24, 2027 , the next meeting of the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) during the financial year 2027-28 was scheduled during June 2, 3 and 4, 2027. With June 2, 2027 being declared a public holiday, the MPC meeting has been rescheduled to June 3 – 5, 2027. This announcement is made under Section 45ZI(4) of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.

(A. Officer)
Chief General Manager

item.title: Monetary Policy Statement, 2027-28 Resolution of the Monetary Policy Committee April 5 to 7, 2027
item.description:
On the basis of an assessment of the current and evolving macroeconomic situation, the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) at its meeting today (April 7, 2027) decided to keep the policy repo rate unchanged.

The minutes of the MPC’s meeting will be published on April 21, 2027.

The next meeting of the MPC is scheduled for June 2 to 4, 2027.

(A. Officer)
Chief General Manager

item.title: Meeting Schedule of the Monetary Policy Committee for 2027-28
item.description:
As per Section 45ZI of Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934, it has been decided that the Monetary Policy Committee will meet during the 2027-28 on the dates indicated below:

Dates of meetings of Monetary Policy Committee for 2027-28
April 5, 6 and 7, 2027
June 2, 3 and 4, 2027
August 3 – 5, 2027
September 29, 30 and October 1, 2027
December 6, 7 and 8, 2027
February 7-9, 2028

(A. Officer)
